run_smplx_mesh_rendering: run the CLI to load SMPL-X data and render 3D mesh videos from a dataset
run_multiperson_mesh_rendering: run the CLI with --load_multiperson to render SMPL-X meshes for multiple people in a sequence
run_audio_video_rendering: run the CLI with --anno audio to render videos with audio tracks merged via ffmpeg
compute_lbs_from_batch: compute SMPL-X mesh vertices from a batch of body, rotation, translation, and shape features
load_and_visualize_data: load a BaseDataset, compute SMPL-X vertices, render frames, and save as MP4 video files
